decisions.reason: The low-cost coupling accessory builds directly on the firm's core trailer know-how and supports after-sales revenue, so keeping it costs little even though it was not observed recently.
The box trailer series is the heart of the firm's accumulated production knowledge, and the firm can read its market feedback and keep improving it.
Car transporters draw on related chassis and axle expertise in a professional niche the firm has now assimilated, though their nearness to the dropped low-bed line adds some risk.
High covers complement the core box trailers with known materials and channels, so the firm can exploit them easily.
This line stays within core competence, but its overlap with Product B makes consolidation plausible, so it is kept with an elevated withdrawal risk.
